title: link
description: What servers link answers with -o json: the link that opens a server's page. A person or script gets the link again after the terminal that ran serve is gone (ADR-S04).

kind.description: Always Link, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: The link that opens the page.

url.description: The address of the server's page with its token as ?token=. Opening it leaves the token in a cookie, so the page's calls pass the server's token guard (ADR-S04).
